title: Supplementary material: Art and Architectural Argumentation Ontology
description: Ontology file (CRMaaa 1.5.4.2), use-case data in Turtle, and the scripts and queries for Sections 5 and 6 of the article "Art and Architectural Argumentation Ontology: A CIDOC CRM Compatible Ontology for Semantically Representing Historical Research Data" (ACM Journal on Computing and Cultural Heritage). Data and ontology: CC BY-SA 4.0; code: MIT; CIDOC CRM 7.1.3: CC BY 4.0.
